Definition: from θήρ (a wild animal, as game); hunting, i.e. (figuratively) destruction:--trap.
BiblicalUsage: The word thḗra is the Bible's way of saying a trap, hunting. In Romans 11:9, a trap, and a stumblingblock.
TheologicalSignificance: A table turned into a trap warns me that even good gifts can snare a heart that refuses to see.
